about: Wartime air bases drawn by template in Graphics > Buildings Period (native/docs/terrain/infra.md, "Generated bases"). Each is at roughly the right place; its layout is generated, not traced, by its nation's template (US: us-pacific-strip; Japan: ijn-solomons-field; UK: raf-station; Germany: luftwaffe-field). The famous fields (Henderson Field) are not here: infra::period::FIELDS draws them; Munda is here for its Japanese years and FIELDS draws it after. size: fighter-strip or bomber-field; headingDeg (optional) a hint for the runway's heading, degrees clockwise from true north; where today's map has a runway near the point the runway is laid along it. A European template's size picks its kind: an RAF bomber-field a Class A station, fighter-strip a grass fighter station; a Luftwaffe bomber-field a Fliegerhorst, fighter-strip a Feldflugplatz. surface (optional): gravel.
